pages.title: Egyptian Construction
pages.text: Ancient Egypt was renowned for its monumental architecture. These $(egyptian)building materials$() allow you to recreate temples, tombs, and pyramids.$(br2)Most blocks have matching stairs, slabs, and walls.

pages.title: Stone Blocks
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Sandstone Bricks$(): Classic$(li)$(item)Sandstone Brick Tiles$(): Decorative$(li)$(item)Limestone Bricks$(): White stone$(li)$(item)Nile Mud Brick$(): Adobe-style$(li)$(item)Obelisk Stone$(): Monument stone$(li)$(item)Sunbaked Clay$(): Terracotta

pages.title: Sandstone Pillar
pages.text: Classic Egyptian column. Rotates when placed. Use for temple entrances and ceremonial halls.

pages.title: Wood Types
pages.text: Two native wood types are available:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Sycamore$(): Sacred tree wood$(li)$(item)Date Palm$(): Desert palm wood$(br2)Both provide full block sets: logs, planks, stairs, slabs, fences, and gates.
